key_insight: Classical Houdayer cluster updates amplify the diversity of quantum-generated maximum independent set solutions by up to 11,923×.
engineering_relevance: Post-processing can extract more distinct optimal configurations—and sometimes better solutions—from existing quantum measurements without additional quantum sampling.
method: Seed solution sets with measurements from QuEra’s Aquila analog quantum device.
Apply classical Houdayer cluster updates to expand the solution sets.
Measure distinct-solution amplification and coverage against known ground-state degeneracies.
evidence_signal: Across 43 instances, diversity amplification reached a median of 24.3×; median ground-state manifold coverage was 21%, with complete recovery for six instances.
watch_item: The method is non-ergodic, so complete ground-state manifold coverage is not guaranteed.
paper_title: Efficient Ground-State Manifold Amplification for Rydberg Atom Arrays via Houdayer Cluster Updates
